text: __NOTOC__ Junior Inspectors are goblins found in the Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge that lead adventurers to Stormwind City to aid Inspector Snip Snagglebolt.
Jungle Panthers are level 10-11 panthers found in the Lost Isles. They can be found in the western zones of the bigger island.

Juveniles are young pandaren phoenixes hatched from Mature Eggs of Ji-Kun on the upper platforms, after which they fly to the center of the room above Ji-Kun and proceed to rain down aoe attacks to players in the area.
Juvenile Bonestrippers are vultures flying around Roknor in Boneslag in Frostfire Ridge
K'ara, known to the orcs as the Dark Star, was a naaru who came with the draenei to Draenor aboard the Genedar.
The K'arani Terrace is the northwestern-most corner of Karabor in . During the siege of the temple by the Iron Horde, it appears to have taken serious damage from iron stars.
Just Normal Beans are obtained by appraising the Magical Sprouting Beans with Rax's Magnifying Glass.

]] The k'thir are a type of faceless one, first encountered on Kul Tiras by the Alliance and Horde. Though smaller than their brethren, they are no less dangerous as they manipulate in the shadows, bending the wills of their enemies and even reality itself. Before the Fourth War, most inhabitants of Kul Tiras thought them mere legend, stories used to warn of the dangers of peering too deep into the waters with tidesage magic, but they now walk among the inhabitants of Stormsong Valley. They look human, as their true appearance only shows upon death or when they want it. Hiding among the populace, they sowed the seeds of their dark masters and took control of the docks at Port Fogtide. They f
Jungle Stalker Cubs are tigers located on the Uncharted Island and on the other expedition isles.
Jungle Tigers are tigers located on the Uncharted Island and on the other expedition isles.
__NOTOC__ Juvenile Knucklebumps are gorillas located on the Uncharted Island and on the other expedition isles.
Jungleweb Victims are web cocoons located around the Terrace of the Fang in Vol'dun. Destroying them may free one of the following: * * *
Junkbrat is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island.
Justin Hammerall is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Junkyard Tinkering can be accessed from Pascal-K1N6 at Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
K'thir Darkspeakers are k'thir located in the Vale of Eternal Twilight. Many of them have disguised themselves as familiar NPCs usually inhabiting the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Junkheap Roaches are cockroaches found on Mechagon Island and in Operation: Mechagon.
Jun-Ti is a mogu located in the Unknown Crypt during Island Expeditions.
Ka'zir is an aqir boss located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. It is part of the Hivemind encounter.
The Jumbo Seaforium Charge is provided as an objective for Our Only Hope. It is used to destroy the lock on the Scourge Enclosure.
K.C. R1C3 is a Mechagon mechagnome who participates in the Darkmoon Faire dancing contest.

Ka'rolel is a vorkai located at Claw's Edge in Ardenweald. She offers a buff when Claw's Edge is empowered through the use of the Anima Conductor in the Heart of the Forest. Her buff is mutually exclusive with that of Buoruon and Sir Sweetthistle.

The term Junker Wastes appears in previews of Mechagon Island, representing the scrapyard territories of the Rustbolt Resistance, probably aligning to the Heaps and the town of Rustbolt. The Mechagon mechagnomes of the resistance were also previously referred to as junker gnomes by Blizzard. Junker Cannon, Junker Harvester, Junker Jeep, Junker Trike, Junker Turret, and Lil Junker Town all exist in the game files but were never added.
Juvenile Flysnatchers are hornswogs located in the Misty Vale in Thaldraszus.
Junkyard Blueprints Binder would drop from Scrapthief Grillin on Mechagon Island.
Junior Racing Champion is a feat of strength achievement earned by becoming a legendary racer and course maker using the Junior Timekeeper's Racing Belt.
Kalaran is a drake of the black dragonflight. His humanoid form is a human male named Kalaran Windblade.

Kalo'thera was a celebrated high priestess in the Sisterhood of Elune centuries before the War of the Ancients. Many in the Sisterhood consider Kalo'thera almost a demigoddess. It is said that she ascended to the stars in the temple of Elune in Hajiri.

's pedestal. The runes on the right and left sides, past the Z-like runes, are identical to the middle rune. For the meaning, see Frostmourne's article.]] . Ice Stones are related to Ahune, which means that the runes may be kalimag - possibly Aquan or Auran as ice elementals are conglomerates of water and air.]] Kalimag is the standard language spoken by all elementals. Kalimag is an obscure tongue spoken only by a few scholars, for the native speakers (elementals) are rarely encountered in any sort of friendly capacity. Kalimag appears to have several dialects including Ignan (fire), Aquan (water), Terran (earth), and Auran (air). One dialect exists for each elemental type living on the Ele

Kadrak is an orc quest giver located at the Mor'shan Rampart in the Northern Barrens and later at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Kadrak was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was accompanied by Captain Shatterskull.

Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf quest giver located in a camp southwest of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. She and Gaxim Rustfizzle have both been missing since the Cataclysm, possibly having been killed by the Horde who established themselves in the area.

.]] .]] Kaliri are a magnificent species of bird bred by the arakkoa as their attack pets and guardians. The females tend to be more rare than the males. Hunted to near extinction for its feathers, the kaliri has developed keen senses. Kaliri take flight immediately after hatching. Kaliri hatchlings feast on grubs when they're young, and eventually graduate to anything smaller than themselves. Apparently, unlike other birds, kaliri mothers don't chew their hatchlings' food for them. Terokk's minions have been attempting to corrupt these birds before they hatch, which would make them mindlessly serve Terokk. Corrupted kaliri can often be found where Terokk's minions are found. Heroes have bee

Kamagua (or Kamagua Harbor) is a tuskarr port settlement on the northwestern shore of the Isle of Spears, and the largest tuskarr village in the Howling Fjord. The Kalu'ak, a tuskarr faction, run the area, led by their local chieftain Elder Atuik. The town is a major stopping point in the nomadic travels of many different tuskarr clans. The town is connected via boat to Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight, which is a great sea turtle named Green Island. The round-backed buildings of Kamagua, which look like monstrous fish, have lower levels dug into the frozen, rocky earth, which makes them easier to keep warm. After the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeards visited the port. They
Kalimdor Explorer is a meta exploration achievement earned for exploring all the zones in the continent of the Kalimdor. Required for the meta-achievement Universal Explorer.

Kajaro Field is an area in the eastern section of Bilgewater Port, in Kezan. It is the Bilgewater Buccaneers' home footbomb field. Just before the Cataclysm, a match between the Bilgewater Buccaneers and the Steamwheedle Sharks was being played. Thanks to the goblin adventurer, the home team managed to win, but the corrupted dragon Deathwing suddenly appeared and awoke Mount Kajaro causing an eruption and earthquakes throughout the island, thus ending the time to celebrate.
The Kaleki Cloak drops from General Husam in Lost City of the Tol'vir.

Kalasan was once a Forsaken messenger to the banshee Queen, Sylvanas Windrunner. Upon finding evidence of communication between a traitor in Undercity and Kel'Thuzad, he went to tell Sylvanas of his suspicions, leading him only to Varimathras, Sylvanas' traitorous advisor. Varimathras killed Kalasan in order to keep his communications unknown.
Kalimdor Eagle Eggs are looted from Kalimdor Eagle Nests, found primarily along Webwinder Path and Boulderslide Ravine in Stonetalon Mountains.
Kafa-Crazed Mountain Goats are goats located in Kun-Lai Summit.
Kafa'kota Berries can be found in Kafakota Bushes on Kota Peak, as well as directly on the ground inside the yak caves on the mountain.

Kalan'ii is a level 91 elite crab located on an island in the pond at the southeastern end of the Summer Fields of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Although Kalan'ii is an elite, it has no drops of note and has a short (roughly five minute) respawn timer.
Kaellin Tarvane is holding the portal to Tol Barad from Stormwind City at the Eastern Earthshrine.
__NOTOC__ Kalen Trueshot is a night elf quest giver located at Trueshot Point in the Stonetalon Mountains. He is taking out the Warsong Wing Commanders.

A Kaliri Egg is found at in a nest northwest of the flight master at the Path of the Light in east-central . It contains the Giant Kaliri Egg. A hundred or so yards to the south is rare warp stalker Insha'tar, which drops the Boots of the Shadowborn and 10-20x Garrison Resources.
__NOTOC__ Kalaena Brightstar is a blood elf located at Pinchwhistle Gearworks in the Spires of Arak. Her traveling companion is Douglas Fellworth.

__NOTOC__ Kanai Griffith is a Forsaken art teacher located on the mountain ridge on the southeastern side of Coldarra in the Borean Tundra, where he is instructing his two students, Fara and Xega. A Skeletal Mount can also be found nearby.
__NOTOC__ Kal'delar is ancient elven military city in ruins on the southwestern shores of Val'sharah. The ruins have been overrun by the Murkwater naga.
Kai Vilhelmsen was a voice actor who voiced the Wind Serpents in the Warcraft universe.
__NOTOC__ Kal'okkar is a kaliri located in Skethyl Mountains above Skettis in Terokkar Forest.
__NOTOC__ Kailea Windfeather is a night elf located at the Moonfall Roost in Suramar.

Kalimos, Primal Lord is a powerful elemental, seemingly made out of all four elements, native to Un'Goro Crater in the Journey to Un'Goro expansion for Hearthstone. He is not considered an Elemental Lord, but is "a bit like Murmur". While they were exploring the top of Fire Plume Ridge, Professor Doyle and Eddie Malone observed Kalimos and several of its servants, which looked like smaller versions of it. Eddie noted in his journal that the smaller elementals venturing to the volcano seemed to be fascinated with Kalimos, and that the Primal Lord's servants would copy something from one of the little elementals and then spin off a completely different elemental. Doyle claimed to have never se

Initially encountered by Maiev, Tyrande Whisperwind, and Malfurion, Kael agrees to help stop Illidan from blowing up the world in exchange for escorting his supply caravan headed to Dalaran through Scourge controlled territory. Eventually he would align himself and his people with the demon hunter to find a cure for his people's magic addiction.
Kaja'Cola Balloons are hot air balloons, advertizing kaja'Cola, flying above Kezan. They are non-targetable.
__NOTOC__ Kakapo are flightless parrots with long lifespans. They hop along the ground and shake fruits from trees.
Kachota the Exiled is a taunka that can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
Kalo Broadhorn is a Highmountain tauren located in the Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. He is seen speaking with Krathok Moltenfist.

Kaldorei Windgryphs are undead hippogryphs located in Val'sharah. They can be found flying around the skies above Black Rook Hold's courtyard. Reanimated Archers are mounted on them. Some can be seen above Black Rook Hold Arena.

Kalimdor Airlines is a flight master platform located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. It's run by Gringer and Kebok is also standing here. A Warchief's Command Board is placed here, and a Zul'Gurub Protector Stone hangs on the building as well.
__NOTOC__ Kaluriak the Alchemist is a dragonman located in Island Expeditions.

Kalliope's Rest is located in western Bastion. It is a shrine that contains many powerful artifacts run by scholars currently being taken over by Forsworn. It's primary artifact is the Spear of Kalliope, guarded by the two Servants of Kalliope.
Kaarisma is a draenei who participates in the Darkmoon Faire's dancing contest.
Karrina Mekenda is a dwarf pet trainer located in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.

__NOTOC__ Katherine the Pure is a human paladin and paladin trainer located in the Cathedral of Light in the city of Stormwind. She serves to instruct hopeful paladins on the martial ways of the Light and can be found in the cathedral's eastern wing, in a room adjacent to the main hall, alongside fellow paladin trainers Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Arthur the Faithful. Following the death of Tirion Fordring during the Battle for Broken Shore, she joined the Order of the Silver Hand and moves to the Sanctum of Light to serve the new Highlord of the Silver Hand. She is seen in the Armory of the Silver Hand and sometimes goes to pray in front of a crypt in Hall of Champions.

Kartra Bloodsnarl was an elite level 85 Alterac Valley battlemaster located in the Hall of the Brave in the Valley of Honor, in the orcish city of Orgrimmar during the Call to Arms: Alterac Valley. She was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Alterac Valley).

.]] ]] Kaplak is an orc rogue trainer located in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the Darkspear Rebellion when the Darkspears liberated the town, he was stealthed and around him was a killed Kor'kron Overseer. He joined the Uncrowned and is found in the Hall of Shadows. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, Kaplak was giving instructions to 7th Legion Archers, 7th Legion Scouts, 7th Legion Riflemen, and High Overlord's Vanguards. He traveled to the Dragon Isles where he can be found at the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores. He later participated in the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill and was seen feasting with his fellow Shattered Hand.
__NOTOC__ Karos Razok is a Forsaken flight master located at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Karen Taylor is a human mining and blacksmithing vendor located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. When the Scourge attacked Lakeshire, she went to fight them alongside guards.
Kaya Flathoof is a tauren quest giver located at Grimtotem Post in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Katrina Shimmerstar is a gnome candy vendor located in the Commons in Ironforge. Other than selling candy, she also gives information about Hallow's End and what can be done during this event.

__NOTOC__ Master Kariel Winthalus was a blood elf loremaster. He fled the devastation of Quel'Thalas and ended up in the ruins of Eldre'Thalas, now known as Dire Maul. He was incinerated by Prince Tortheldrin while trying to gain knowledge from the Shen'dralar ancients found within. His librams indicate that he ventured to Kalimdor sometime after Prince Kael'thas pledged his allegiance to Illidan Stormrage. They make reference to both Kael and Illidan, praising both and thus making clear whom he serves. The character was eventually renamed to Telmius Dreamseeker.
Kaw's War Halberd can be found beside Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer's corpse in the Borean Tundra.

__NOTOC__ Karen No is a human found on the southern tower of Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. She stands near Johnny Yes, Willy Maybe, and Kibli Killohertz. Karen No is the line chief at the Alliance Infragreen air base and is second-in-command to Kibli Killohertz. She is responsible for maintenance and combat readiness of the Infragreen bombers. Prospective pilots report to her for their plane assignments. The planes are equipped with bombs to attack ground targets and air-to-air rockets for defense and taking out aerial targets. Also, the places are fitted with an Infragreen defense shield, on-board fire extinguishers and a fix-it 'bot for in-flight repairs.
Kaw's Roost is a very small location within Borean Tundra that allows Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer to watch over the area.

Kathra'natir, also spelled Kathra'Natir, is a powerful nathrezim who has been archenemy of the Council of Tirisfal ever since the creation of the first Guardian. He was eventually tricked into possessing Meryl Felstorm, becoming imprisoned in Meryl's body, but during the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth he broke free to threaten the Council once more, leading to the reforming of the Tirisgarde.
Kathorn's Power Cell drops from Rune-Smith Kathorn at Dun Argol in the Grizzly Hills.

Karnum's Glade is a Cenarion Circle respite located in the middle of the Cenarion Wildlands in Desolace and under the care and direction of Karnum Marshweaver. Cenarion Hippogryphs fly around in the air above the glade as well as the Wildlands around it.

Karn's Smithy is a blacksmithing shop found on the lower rise of Thunder Bluff. This is also the only place in the city to find a forge and anvil. The place is run by Karn Stonehoof, and several other members of his clan can be found here.

Kasim Sharim is a gnome quest giver located at Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands. He is a user of blood magic. It is unknown what happened with Kasim when the Ironmarch took control of the cave. He may have been killed or escaped.

Kasha is Orkus the Kingslayer's mount. She was found injured in Icecrown, by Orkus. He carried her to the Shadow Vault, where the Knights of the Ebon Blade helped him heal her. Adventurers of the Horde meet Kasha during the Orkus quest chain in Hillsbrad Foothills. At the end of the chain, Orkus, who is severely injured by Ivar Bloodfang and his war party, wishes in his dying words to give Kasha a new home, preferably somewhere cold. After Orkus dies, Kasha can be seen flying around Hillsbrad, occasionally stopping to perch upon a tall hill overlooking the Tarren Mill farm.

Karl is a worgen found in the Forward Command in the Southern Barrens. Occasionally, he can be seen working on a wheel on a ballista. He tried Sam Trawley's Big Haunch of Stormsnout Meat but was zapped by a bolt of electricity. His status after the fall of Northwatch Hold and Fort Triumph just prior to the destruction of Theramore Isle is unknown.

__NOTOC__ Kata Arina is a pandaren located at the Path of Serenity in Shrine of Seven Stars. She is paying attention to Ying Thunderspear. A version of her appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight where she can be saved.

The Kargesh clan (or Korgesh) is a clan of mogu that have traveled from an unknown location to the Mogu'shan Palace to pay tribute to their king while seeking to prove themselves amongst their rival clans of Harthak and Gurthan. This clan has strong warriors that favor large weapons and fire magic. Following their defeat by heroes, they quickly blamed the other clans and began an all-out brawl. The outcome of this brawl is unknown.

Kapik is a kodo mount of Sunwalker Dezco first found at Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds. Kapik is later seen at the Shattered Convoy, and after Kor's death in Dawnchaser Retreat, but is not seen afterward.
Karsar the Bloodletter is a saurok found during the Brewmoon Festival scenario.
__NOTOC__ Kar is a pandaren located on top a mountain peak north of Sri-La Village in the Jade Forest.
Kat is a Forsaken located at the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Kargathar Proving Grounds is a camp. It consists of three areas. The first is an area where members of the Shattered Hand clan torture prisoners, each other, and a hostile but passive mandragora. The second is an arena where Kargath demands that Khadgar and the adventurer's party kill 100 of his clan to advance. The third is a village that connects to the Umbral Halls and Bladefist Rise. Most of the village is empty decoration, but it can be accessed by jumping off one of the towers.
Kaya is Red Skymane's pet fox, found running around a hut in Snowmane Village in Highmountain. During Evacuate Snowmane, Red picks Kaya up and carries the fox to safety.

Karkora is a world in the Great Dark Beyond. Many ages ago, its mortal denizens faced annihilation at the hands of the monstrous Dimensius the All-Devouring, but the entity's efforts were stopped by a benevolent naaru known as T'uure, who expended its own life energy to shatter into fragments and spark a colossal holy nova which washed away Dimensius' Void energies and banished him from the world.

__NOTOC__ Kariel is an orc or human (depending on the race of the player) warrior that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple during Destiny Unfulfilled.

Karina of Silvermoon is a blood elf mage of the Tirisgarde located in the Hall of the Guardian. Karina later appeared in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. She and the gnome Jubilee Arcspark interrogate a Nethersworn Cultist by polymorphing him very quickly.
__NOTOC__ Karla Fairweather is a human flight master located at the Amber Waves in Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Kasea Angerforge is a Dark Iron dwarf stable master located in Shadowforge City in Blackrock Depths. She is training a pack of Dark Iron Core Hounds.
Karg's Hunting Horn is a quest reward from The Strength of Our Bonds.
Katamawri is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Karkinus the Capsizer is a hermit crab that spawns at the southern end of Sharpscale Coast in southwestern Forbidden Reach. This hermit crab destroyed the Dragonscale Expedition boat.

Kangalo is a rare water strider that spawns when Dragon Isles Herbalists plant Dormant Lifebloom Seeds in the Awakened Soil on Dragonskull Island in Forbidden Reach. It drops herbs. The summoner who planted the seeds is granted bonus loot: 5x Artisan's Mettle, and an Undigested Hochenblume Petal.

Kebok is a goblin located on the Kalimdor Airlines platform in Booty Bay of the Cape of Stranglethorn. Before the Cataclysm, the trolls have been killing agents in the jungle, so Kebok sent adventurers to kill trolls and bring back :Bloodscalp Ears and :Skullsplitter Tusks. Kebok intended on using the tusks as undetectable fake tiger fangs to export to islands in the South Seas.

"Kel'Thuzad and the Forming of the Scourge" is a section of the History of Warcraft, Chapter IV. It is set shortly before Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. Found at: * Reliquary of Scholomance in the Western Plaguelands * Athenaeum of The Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades * The Apothecarium of Undercity - near Herbalism trainers * The Scarlet Bastion (live side) of Stratholme * Southshore Inn in the Hillsbrad Foothills Timeline: * ← Previous book: War of the Spider * → Next book: The Alliance Splinters

Keldran is an orc quest giver located north of the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. During Thrall's tenure as Warchief, Keldran was dedicated to the task of proving to the Alliance that the Horde no longer consorted with demonic powers. He planned to accomplish this by eliminating the Burning Blade presence from the region of Desolace. To that end, Takata Steelblade and Maurin Bonesplitter were sent to Desolace to deal with the general demonic threat there and charged with the specific duty of eliminating the Burning Blade. While Keldran did not seem to have Thrall's official permission for the operation in Desolace, he was convinced that even the Warchief was growing weary of the war with th
__NOTOC__ Keeper Bel'dugur is a Forsaken located in the Apothecarium in the Undercity. From dialogue surrounding one of his quests, it seems he is a member of the Twilight's Hammer.
__NOTOC__ Keeper Moonshade was a night elf quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
__NOTOC__ Kazon is a rare mob orc found by the huts at Render's Camp in Redridge Mountains. He is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer.

Keeper Albagorm was a keeper of the grove located at Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains. Having previously provided quests to adventurers in the area, Albagorm vanished during the Cataclysm. He is believed to have been killed in the faceless one attack on the camp at the peak around that time.

]] The Keepers of Time were bronze dragons hand-picked by Nozdormu to watch over the Caverns of Time, being sufficient caretakers able to deal with most ordinary disturbances to the timeways. After the Dragon Aspects lost their powers, the Keepers of Time became the Timewalkers, aiding the mortals that now watch the timeways.

Keeper Marandis is a keeper of the grove located in Nijel's Point in Desolace. He and his dryad sisters are originally from the Stonetalon Mountains, but came to Desolace on a quest to kill Princess Theradras so they could retrieve Zaetar's body from Maraudon and bring it back to Stonetalon. __NOTOC__

Kelek Skykeeper is a night elf quest giver located at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. After the Cataclysm, he is also seen in the Ruins of Kel'Theril in Winterspring. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he briefly appears in the Dreamgrove.
Kelara is a draenei Sha'tari heirlooms vendor located in the Shrine of Unending Light in Shattrath City.

The stealthy rogue Kelen was well known for his ability to slip away from any pursuit and find his way out of even the most escape-proof traps. Only upon his death did the world learn that his secret was really in the glass-sheathed dagger he carried, Kelen's Dagger of Escape.
Keeping the Enemy at Bay is part of the Shattered Sun Offensive storyline. Once players have recovered the Sun's Reach Harbor, this quest replaces Intercept the Reinforcements.
Keeshan's Survival Knife drops from Homurk at Alther's Mill in the Redridge Mountains for Weapons of War.

.]] The keepers are titanic watchers who were imbued by the Pantheon with their specific likenesses and powers. They are Archaedas, Loken, Thorim, Freya, Mimiron, Hodir, Tyr, Ra, and Odyn. These nine would lead the titan-forged armies against the Black Empire, and later create most of their lesser brethren and shape the world. Some keepers are considered to be legends and myths by other races.

Keeshan's Post is an area in Redridge Mountains north of Stonewatch Keep. It is initially unoccupied, but after AHHHHHHHHHHHH! AHHHHHHHHH!!!, Colonel Troteman will watch Stonewatch Tower through his telescope here. It is named after John J. Keeshan.
Keg Runner Lee is a pandaren flight master located at Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.

Kaz'tik the Manipulator is a mantid member of The Klaxxi that can be found in Klaxxi'vess after being freed from amber in Briny Muck. Kaz'tik is a user of sonic-based magic, particularly using it to control the minds of enemies and kunchong minions. He has trained a kunchong named Kovok. Some time after he was awakened by the wakener, he joined the other Paragons in allying with Garrosh Hellscream who obtained the heart of Y'Shaarj.
Keeper Orremin is a keeper of the grove who watched over a hidden valley in the Stonetalon Mountains which contained a rare plant used for medicines and brews.
Kazra'jin is a powerful forest troll, skilled at doing barrel rolls.
The Keeper of the Cistern is a naga located in the Coilskar Cistern in Shadowmoon Valley.
Keilan Hearthsong is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Kazu is member of the Arakkoa Outcasts located at Talon Watch within the Spires of Arak. He has been experimenting with the Curse of Sethe in order to weaponize it as a weapon against the Adherents of Rukhmar as there is nothing that they fear more than the power of the curse. His previous attempts to bottle the pooled blood have failed. It breaks down and dissipates when it is taken away from Sethe's bones, but he has high hopes for the congealed form of Sethe's blood.
Keira is a human quest giver located outside Stormwind City's gate in Elwynn Forest.

Keen Senses was a pet ability available exclusively to the hydra family of hunter pets, increasing player mastery by an amount depending on level. It was functionally identical to the cat family's Roar of Courage, the spirit beast family's Spirit Beast Blessing, and the tallstrider family's Plainswalking.

Kaz is a dwarven weaponsmith, working in the Royal Armory. He has a wife and two small children. Kaz was caught among the thousands of refugees seeking entry to as the 's attacks began to escalate. Despite his vital work making weapons for the soldiers, Kaz was held back from entry into the city, along with his family. As the human guards and crowd became increasingly hostile to the dwarves, Kaz took up a hammer, but was interrupted by Karos, returning from the , who instructed the guards to let the dwarf through, and admonished the crowd for their attitude. Kaz would later deliver a shipment of s to the Stormwind armory, a gift of .
Keeper Selentia can be found in Shal'Aran in Suramar during the quest Arcane Thirst. She is invulnerable until the two Arcane Tethers are slain. She will also summon Ancient Keepers.
__NOTOC__ Keelay Moongrow is a nightborne located in Suramar. He will only interact with you with a nightborne disguise.
Keeshan's Riverboat is a river boat found just east from Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. This boat is owned by Keeshan.

__NOTOC__ Kel'vax Deathwalker is a Zandalari troll ghost located at the Terrace of Sorrows in Nazmir. He was raised by his parents who were both priests of the loa Bwonsamdi at his shrine in Nazmir. Enticed by heretics at a young age, Kel'vax chose to forsake everything he believed in, and joined the blood troll cultists and worshipers of G'huun. He became a lich, storing his soul in three phylacteries. The blood trolls later made offerings of corpses to him. After being defeated, he briefly appears as .
Keelhaul-In-A-Box is a shredder located on the Banshee's Wail in Dazar'alor. It also appears in the Great Sea still destroyed. When the Alliance attacked, Hobart Grapplehammer piloted it.
Kaza the Skyblade is a Zandalari troll flight master located in the Temple of the Prophet in Zuldazar.
__NOTOC__ Kefolkis the Unburied is a frost wyrm who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Kayn's Cell is a magical cage holding Kayn Sunfury in the Vault of the Wardens.
Keeper Undarius is a keeper of the grove located in the Verdant Wilds in Island Expeditions.
Keefer's Skyreach is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Keefer.
Keeper of the Ossuary starts "The Veiled Ossuary" questline, featuring the restoration of the blue dragonflight. It requires having completed Moving On (Thaldraszus) of the Thaldraszus storyline.
Keith Robert Andreassi DeCandido is the author of the Warcraft novel Cycle of Hatred. In addition, he has written for Warcraft's counterpart universe of StarCraft.

The keyring was a sixth bag slot that could be opened with the button that held a number of keys, most usefully dungeon keys among other keys, with dynamic capacity. Not all keys or items with key in their names were compatible with the keyring. When a player first acquired a key, they automatically acquired a keyring that held compatible keys. The keyring sized dynamically for the number of keys in possession, up to 32 keys.

Kezan's Unstoppable Taint is the Zandalar Tribe necklace for warlocks. The item is part of the armor set called Demoniac's Threads. This item is the last in a series of three upgrades. When a warlock reaches a friendly reputation with the Zandalar Tribe, he may receive the weaker, Rare item called Kezan's Taint by speaking to Al'tabim the All-Seeing for a free quest. At Honored, the item can be upgraded to Epic quality and at Revered it can be upgraded further. Each upgrade is a quest reward which also results in more reputation gains and gold.
Ken'zigla is a jungle troll located in Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains. He knows how to prepare healing draughts.

Kessel's Crossing is the southernmost draenei establishment on Bloodmyst Isle. It features a vendor and a few quest givers. This area of the island has not yet been corrupted by the blood crystals from the Exodars crashing.
Khadgar's Knapsack is a trinket sold by G'eras in Shattrath City for .

Kelkar, though only briefly mentioned, was the father of Draka, making him Thrall's grandfather. Soon after her birth, the new parents showed their child to the rest of the clan. He and his mate Zuura were later exiled by Garad from a Frostwolf village because of Draka's sickness. Years later, before a Kosh'harg celebration where Draka met Durotan, Kelkar and Zuura were forbidden to attend the celebration by Garad. When Draka left for the quest to obtain three ingredients, her parents were sad as they didn't expect her to return. The exact time and cause of his death are not known.

Key to the Searing Gorge gets you the Key to Searing Gorge, which allows you to pass through the Stonewrought Pass tunnel. Note that because of the flight point at Thorium Point, this tunnel is not often used.
Kelly Grant is located in the Lion's Rest of Stormwind City.

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Khadgar's Pipe of Insight |icon=INV_Misc_Pipe_01 |desc=Grants the Hero and friendly nearby units a bonus to mana regeneration.Does not stack with Brilliance Aura. |sell=250 }} Khadgar's Pipe of Insight is a Warcraft III item that used to belong to Khadgar.

Kerta the Bold is a human located in the Arsenal Absolute in Dalaran. She sells axes and polearms weapons. During the purge of Dalaran, she and Valaden Silverblade defended the shop's entrance with weapons in their hands. When the city appeared above Karazhan and the Legion attacked it, she fought against demons in front of the shop.

Kelp'thar Forest is the first zone of Vashj'ir, which is one of the two 80-82 level-up zones in Cataclysm. Breadcrumbs to Vashj'ir come from Stormwind and Orgrimmar in an auto-quest which starts as soon as players step in to their respective faction's city. After a few introductory quests, players can choose to head to Vashj'ir or Hyjal. On the Call of Duty, players will find themselves shipwrecked in Seafarer's Tomb or Legion's Fate in the northern portion of Kelp'thar Forest. Kelp'thar Forest is very heavily phased and is a directed-questing experience. Following the breadcrumbs throughout the three zones of Vashj'ir is straightforward, leading to a natural storyline progression. The other
The Key of Ilgalar drops from General Fangore in the Redridge Mountains.
Kellen Kuhn is a Forsaken flight master located at Hiri'watha Research Station in the Hinterlands.
Kevin K. Griffith is an employee of Blizzard Entertainment, being one of the city/dungeon concept art artists. He is listed as a contributor to the TBC and WotLK expansions.
Kerwin the Destroyer is a goblin engineer located at Fuselight-by-the-Sea in the Badlands. He is building an Explosive Sheep.
Kengtus Pranch the Patient is a jungle troll fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. She died after the portal was destroyed.

Kelsing was one of the One Hundred magi of Arathor, and the nephew of General Lordain. At some point after the Troll Wars, he wrote a missive to an unknown recipient to tell them that Antonius, Decindra, and their apprentices had gone to accompany Thoradin on his quest to find the origins of humanity (which Kelsing considered to be a "fools' errand"). Kelsing himself intended to "remain in Lordaeron" to protect the "city named after [his] uncle" until he was buried next to him.
Kesak is a wolf that is a part of the Uber Town group. It can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.
Kettric is a tauren located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.

Kevin Jordan is a former Game Designer at Blizzard Entertainment. He was one of three original game designers on the World of Warcraft team, after Allen Adham and Eric Dodds. He co-invented and drew the concept for all systems that the game would end up having. He was also the inspiration to introduce two factions (Horde and Alliance) into the game, as well as to have PvP system in World of Warcraft. His work later, post 2003, focused around Class design. He designed all 9 classes from scratch, and all the abilities and spells in vanilla World of Warcraft. He was also the originator of the talent system, designed all talents and iterated on them through next years. He worked on classes until

Kharanos is a bustling little town nestled among the mountain peaks of Dun Morogh. The town is surrounded by the stark wintry wilds of Dun Morogh, so adventure is a common commodity and some of the less tenacious folk in town might pay good coin to complete various tasks in the surrounding region. Kharanos is home to a large forge, a gnomish workshop, and the famous Thunderbrew Distillery, where adventurers can sit down and drink some of the best ale available in the world. For all its quaint charm, Kharanos is a hub of military activity, defending against all manner of threats in the region. Directly to the west is a large cavern inhabited by fierce wendigo. Kick is a level 6 rogue ability that interrupts spellcasting. If Kick interrupts a spell, it also prevents the target from casting any spell from that school for 5 seconds.

__NOTOC__ Kidney Shot is a level 13 rogue ability. It is used to stun monsters or characters, preventing them from escaping or causing further harm to you or allies, and enabling easy attacks from behind. As with all stuns, most bosses are immune to it, although it may be useful against adds.

Khanzo was an orc blademaster of the Blackrock clan, and commander of the Blackrock Scouts, who guarded a demon gate in the Alterac Mountains of Lordaeron. Arthas and the lich Kel'Thuzad killed him along with four other orcs, in order for Kel'Thuzad to commune with the demon lord Archimonde.

Khole Jinglepocket is a Smokywood Pastures goblin vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City during the Feast of Winter Veil event. He is affiliated with He sells lower value holiday related items. His high value counterpart is .

__NOTOC__ Khelden Bremen is a human mage and mage trainer located in Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He can be found on the second floor of the abbey, up the stairs that are in the room second on the left from where you enter the abbey. He is notable for training novice mages the basics of the art of magic.

__NOTOC__ Khan Jehn was the leader of the Magram centaur clan found in Magram Village in Desolace. He held his leadership with his raw strength, making him the biggest and toughest in the entire village. He advocated for the assaults against enemy tribes through his representative, Warug, believing that the Magram will become the strongest tribe through the elimination of others.
Khorium Power Core is a component made by engineers as a part for some high-level items they craft.

Kill Them All! is an introduction quest directing Scryers-affiliated players to the Sanctum of the Stars. The Aldor version of this quest can be found at Kill Them All! (Aldor). This quest is available at reputation with Netherwing after completing Hail, Commander!
__NOTOC__ Kibler's Bits is a consumable given to combat pets. It previously increased the pet's Strength and Stamina by 20 for 1 hour and then increased happiness, but now makes your pet larger.

Killing Spree is an Outlaw rogue talent. It is an instant rogue ability that allows the rogue to deal a large amount of burst damage to an enemy (several enemies with Blade Flurry in their range). It is an exclusive choice node with Dreadblades.
Kill It With Fire! is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating 3 Burning Souls during the High Prophet Barim encounter in Lost City of the Tol'vir on Heroic difficulty.
Kilag Gorefang is an orc first found on the Lost Isles and then returned to the mainland in Stonetalon Mountains.
Kil'jaeden's Cunning is a passive talented warlock ability, available at level 90.

Kichi of the Hundred Kegs is a pandaren located on the lower level of the Summer Terrace in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He gives information about brewmasters and some scenarios. He also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight and can be saved.
Kiang Redwhisker is a pandaren located at the Emperor's Step in the Shrine of Seven Stars where he can be found having a staring contest with Master Zhang. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

The Kidnapped Redridge Citizens are the unnamed citizens captured from Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. They are rescued by the Bravo Company and are later located at Shalewind Canyon before returning to Lakeshire.
__NOTOC__ Kik'tik is a mantid flight master found in Klaxxi'vess of the Dread Wastes.
Khep-Re is a rare beetle that is located at the Unearthed Grounds in Stonetalon Mountains.
Khrim Powderkeg is a dwarven mountaineer that can be found at the Frostmane Front in Dun Morogh during the Legion invasions.
__NOTOC__ Kieule is a nightborne located in the Menagerie of Suramar City in Suramar.

__NOTOC__ Khazaduum is an eredar brute located beneath Nath'raxas Spire in Krokuun while the world quest Khazaduum (quest) is available. A time echo of him can be found at Triumvirate's End in Eredath, reliving the flight of the draenei. He was the first of his kind, willingly undergoing the experiment that would turn him into an eredar brute shortly after the eredar joined the Burning Legion.
__NOTOC__ Killsaw is a gnomebot located in the Fleeting Forest on Mechagon Island.
Khogov the Expunger is a devourer located in the Shattered Grove.

King Bangalash is a tiger found in Northern Stranglethorn on the top of a small hill on the opposite side of the road of the Ziata'Jai Ruins. He is the main antagonist of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. He is quite tough, and he summons two level 29 Jungle Panthers when he is low on health. Due to his stunning looks, King Bangalash is popular as a hunter pet. He was briefly famous for being the only hunter pet with the skill Cobra Reflexes, but the following patch, 2.1, made it available for all pets. Hemet Nesingwary Jr. wants Bangalash's head. Despite Hemet's request, Bangalash appears in the Brawler's Guild fights as part of the Stranglethorn Streak rumble encounter.

Kirin'Var Village is located in the southernmost floating island of the Netherstorm. Note that although the village's name appears on the Netherstorm map, there is no actual subzone named Kirin'Var Village. Instead, it is separated into four subzones, which contain different types of mobs — Wizard Row, Town Square, Chapel Yard, and Violet Tower.

Kirsta Deepshadow is a human quest giver located in a hidden camp in a small dip in the mountains northeast of the Northridge Lumber Camp in the Western Plaguelands. Based on her comments at the completion of her questline, she appeared to have connections with Elling Trias - she said she'd report to "Elling... I mean to Stormwind". She has been missing since the Cataclysm, possibly having moved on to other missions since the defeat of the Scarlet Crusade.
Kin Lighteye is a high elf warrior who has tried to turn his back on the magic of his race but cannot fully deny the addiction in his blood.

The King's Road was a pass in Alterac that ran along the towns of Strahnbrad and Andorhal, and some other unnamed villages and farmsteads. Falric grew up in this area. Most of the farmers here were independent and isolationists, which meant that they brought their produce and livestock in to the villages, sold it, and came home. The area was protected by the Regional Defenders. During the Third War, Arthas Menethil, Jaina Proudmoore, and Falric passed through here to investigate the villages and reports of a strange plague. A group of bandits attacked local villagers, but they were defeated by the prince. Murlocs were also present near a river. A magical healing fountain was also located her
Kingston's Primers are primers designed in Area 52. They are using demon's power as an explosive. It requires four Demonic Rune Stones to activate.

.]] King's Square is a Stratholme district located right after the city's main entrance. It leads northwest into Market Row and east to Festival Lane. King's Square holds numerous perpetually burning buildings, including Stone Crow Tavern, Leeka's Shields & Maces, the Orphanage, and Ezra Grimm's Premium Tobacco.
King Llane I of the House of Wrynn is a statue located in Stormwind City.
Kip Trawlskip is a goblin flight master located at Kamagua in the Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ Kirea Moondancer is a night elf grand master herbalism trainer located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.

A powerful lich who reported directly to the Lich King himself, Kirkessen the Zealous was instrumental in the Scourge's success in countless battles. Ultimately, he suffered a grievous blow from Lord Maxwell Tyrosus during a failed assault on Light's Hope Chapel, and is no longer able to assume a corporeal form. Kirkessen is mentioned in the Compendium of Fallen Heroes found in Acherus, and is considered a hero by the Scourge.

"Kirin Tor Monthly (March Issue)" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic. It's the March Issue of the Kirin Tor Monthly. It is most likely a parodic reference to real-life FAQ-guides for young people with limited to no sexual experience.

King Ping is a rare penguin found on the western islands of Howling Fjord. King Ping is a slightly larger penguin that can usually be found around Scalawag Point. He is noted to be one of the hardest Northrend mobs to find, despite having a 24-hour spawn rate (unconfirmed), as players are often doing the Kalu'ak daily quest which takes place directly where he spawns, so he doesn't stay unslain for long.
Kimbiza is a jungle troll flight master located at Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra.
__NOTOC__ Kir'altius was a Moon Guard sorcerer who was fighting against the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. He was killed by Archimonde.

King Haldor of the Rocky Cliffs was a great vrykul king. He is laid to rest in his funeral boat located in Ymiron's Seat, Utgarde Pinnacle. He was strangely not cremated at sea, perhaps to gain his ability.

King's Gate is located within Gilneas. It is a smaller version of the Greymane Wall, and the brother gate to Queen's Gate, defending the pass towards the Duskhaven area. The King's Gate is the higher, more northerly of the two. Its road connects Greymane Manor to what became the Stagecoach Crash Site, with a ruined path that formerly lead to Gilneas City. It was likely built by Genn Greymane as a secondary defense structure should the Greymane Wall fall.

Kirthaven is a Wildhammer village located in the northeastern part of the Twilight Highlands, in the slopes of Mount Thunderstrike. It is a major spiritual center for the Wildhammer dwarves, and the home of their Grand Shaman. It is the only place where the varied clans can come together in peace. The village features typical Wildhammer architecture, with stone houses chiseled into the ground itself. Most of these are clustered around a central square with a fountain. The village also has an aviary area with the flight master, roosts and many hatchlings frolicking around. The Wildhammer honor their dead heroes here before burying them with their gryphons atop Mount Thunderstrike. Although th

Kim Horn is a Forsaken guild vendor found in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. She was evacuated during the Battle for Lordaeron and relocated to the Gates of Orgrimmar in Orgrimmar. After the Forsaken reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, Kim moved there.

Kings under the Mountain is an Archaeology achievement earned for collecting the artifacts of the various Dark Iron thanes. These artifacts are all dwarven artifacts, and as such have no minimum archaeology skill requirement to collect the archaeology fragments required.

Kinnel is a level 35 quest giver who can be found circling - slowly - around the campfire at Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn. He is apparently fond of looking at the stars all night, but the burning braziers from the nearby Ruins of Zul'Mamwe are preventing the area from getting too dark. Kinnel would like to see the braziers put out so he can carry on with his observations again. During the events of Rise of the Zandalari, he was poisoned but soon healed by Bwemba.
Kim of the Mountain Winds is a pandaren located at the Grassy Cline in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The Kirin Tor Offensive is the Alliance reputation faction introduced in patch 5.2. It is personally led by Jaina Proudmoore, leader of the Kirin Tor and Dalaran. Its base camp is named the Violet Rise. The Offensive is composed of Silver Covenant high elves combined with war mages and warriors of the Kirin Tor. Their main goals are to prevent the Horde from obtaining powerful artifacts from Emperor Lei Shen and to also fight the coalition of Zandalari and mogu threatening Pandaria. Daily quests for the Kirin Tor Offensive are divided into two categories, only one of which can be chosen per day: PVE-oriented tasks, or PVP-based missions. The Kirin Tor Mana Crystal is provided for Overpowered (Alliance).
__NOTOC__ Kirin Tor Defenders are members of the Kirin Tor Offensive found on the Isle of Thunder. While dressed the same as Kirin Tor Guardians, they use warrior abilities rather than mage ones.
Kiryn's Throwing Stars dropped from Devious Wood Sprites along Sea Mist Ridge in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Kinkade Jakobs is a gnome found next to Ernst ten Bosch, the flightmaster in Stormshield.
King Deepbeard is a sea giant boss located at the Deepbeard's Cove in Eye of Azshara. He is the father of Prince Oceanus.

Kindle Candlecrafter is a Bluewax kobold found in Candle Rock in Highmountain during Candle of Command and Burn the Candle at Both Ends. He appears to be an expert at creating candles and working with wax. During Candle of Command, Kindle is the third kobold to appear to be offered a job by the adventurer. During Burn the Candle at Both Ends, he is busy creating the Candleking's Special Candle, which the adventurer helps him put the finishing touch on.

Kipp Brightwick is a Bluewax kobold found on the upper level of Candle Rock in Highmountain. He is busy creating new candles, but if asked he will tell the story of the Bluewax kobolds. Like the rest of the Bluewax, Kipp is normally , but turns while the player is wearing the Skull of Bossing Around, and while they have the "Friends For Life (Okay, Neutral)" buff.
King Blastakhan is a troll golem located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. Zi'mo the Empowered watches it fight Da Righteous Voodoo.
Kirin Tor Peacekeepers are human and gnome mages located in front of Suramar City in Suramar.
Kirin Tor Tomes are flying tomes located at Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Kisha is a tortollan located in Nazmir. She attended the funeral of King Rastakhan in Dazar'alor and remained in the city during Talanji's coronation.
__NOTOC__ The Kirin Tor Emissary is a human located in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City.

Kiryn's Pouch is the property of Shademaster Kiryn, one of the Horde fighters brought by General Nazgrim to the Jade Forest. The pouch offers the below quest only after players speak with Kiryn during Higher Ground. It used to contain her throwing stars, which have been pilfered by the nearby sprites. The pouch hangs from a branch behind Kiryn, located at the border of the Wreck of the Sky Shark and Sea Mist Ridge.
Kip Wingnut is a goblin flight master located in Waning Glacier in Tiragarde Sound.
__NOTOC__ Kindleweb Creepers are fire spiders located in Island Expeditions.

Kirin Tor Keepers are human mages who channel magic into a scale of the blue aspect on the top of the Nexus in the Borean Tundra during A Bolt from the Blue. After the spell is complete, they clap, laugh, and cheer.

Kirin Tor Guardians are humans and high elves who briefly appear in the Hall of the Guardian after being recruited by Guardian Alar. After spawning, they run through the Hall. They serve as the troops accompanying the Class Hall champions.
